purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software. It handles monthly claim/receipt aggregation processing (国保・請求書集計処理 – national health insurance claim summary), generating printed claim forms and updating receipt DB files. It reads a temporary indexed file of receipt data, aggregates totals by insurer category, and writes output for printing and DB update.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance)

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese multi-byte characters (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), causing comment text to appear garbled. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the JMA ORCA project, with a long maintenance history. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 130323 bytes; the procedure division is not shown but inferred from indicators (98 PERFORMs, 61 CALLs, 3 GOTOs).
